Unit 6 — Jumping

Platforming, from the inside: a physics flick (gravityScale & jumpForce), Ground tag collision counting (jumpsRemaining), waypoint moving platforms (Platform.cs), and moving double jumps onto StatManager.

Lessons

IDTitleWhat you build / learn
6.1Gravity & Jump: The First Flickscene-switched gravityScale, isPlatformer, and AddForceY()
6.2Ground Collision & Jump CountjumpsRemaining, OnCollisionEnter2D(), and CompareTag("Ground")
6.3Moving Platforms & Jump TuningPlatform.cs (wayPoints, isOn, SetParent()) and heavy jump tuning
6.4Double Jump: Moving Jumps to StatManagermoving jumpsRemaining and maxJumps onto StatManager + boss prep studio
6.5Platforming Studio: The Gauntletfive sections, one room, blind testers

Concepts this unit owns

Physics + persistent budgets: separating horizontal speed from gravity fall speed, tracking jump budgets in an integer counter instead of a bool, parenting on moving platforms, and deciding which stats live permanently on StatManager. CED: AAP-1, AAP-2, CRD-2.
